title: How to Write a Job Application Email (With Examples)
description:
The best way to stand out from other applicants is to write a job application email to send to potential employers. Your job application email serves as your first point of contact with a potential employer, and it's important to make a good first impression. But where do you start? Today, we'll break down how to write a job application email with an example and talk about what you should include in yours before you send it off.
